label: Causal propagation of brute contingency under fixed governing laws
summary:
The same contingent, uncaused founder without any #312 existence reason is modeled under three population boundaries. Conservation of persistent individuals excludes late entry. Capacity one permits the same late candidate in the founder’s absence yet excludes it alongside the founder. Unrestricted birth inputs admit an additional uncaused agent at every specified later tick, preserving prior presences and changing one detector. This defeats the bare shared-premise inference without adjudicating which boundary is metaphysically necessary. Paired interventions on a connected three-site path give every pair assignment and preserve total parity; one optional unmatched endpoint flip gives all triples. In a fixed XOR evidence channel the truth of a measured change survives precisely when its two offsets agree. The subject note compares closure of a calibrated inventory, dispositional, best-system, necessitarian and classical-theistic restrictions, the same-agent strict-norm conflict, matched standards of explanatory adequacy, and the existing B2/C2 routes. #1874’s independent infinite-closure obligation remains. One can exclude a specified change on a retained target by accounting exhaustively for its ways of receiving influence, even if the source inventory stays open. A violation can reveal an unmodeled coupling while leaving its bearer’s existential origin open. All three formal results passed binding, Comparator and NanoDa. The existing c056ad5c excludes two actual concrete roots of the same grounding relation at a selected world under its other-cause, identity-uniqueness and application premises. It needs no necessary founder. Transport to retained-founder continuations and replacement of local absence of production by actual grounding-root status are separate application obligations. The owner-requested continuation tests actual productive exercise after perfect containment. A two-sided borrowing trap, matched admitted-versus-exercised routes, a direct product bypass and a primitive-exercise basis distinguish path credit from supplied production without identifying Supply with adequate explanation. Existing same-source cognition does not yet make an apprehended specification operative in production. Source-to-record assemblies and omission controls separately identify assertion scope, actual realization, provenance and truth-preserving transport, with an impersonal copying counterpart. The current assessment retains the moderate E preference and the strongest necessary impersonal rival; no new root discharge is claimed. Prior containment-scope assessment from merged PR-1927 remains preserved in the note's Metaphysical explosion and containment section: No inference from one brute contingent existent to unrestricted possibility is established. Within the fixed Boolean selector interpretation, single-time richness is exactly the obstruction to a uniformly exact old-record forecast, and adjacent-pair richness is exactly the obstruction to a universal first-order transition profile excluding a wholly future adjacent pair. Two constant suffixes separate the first two levels; four parity-recursive suffixes separate adjacent-pair from finite richness while obeying a common deterministic law with two-bit memory. The existing eventual-constancy control separates finite from whole-suffix richness. This weakens the assumptions for these selected local consequences without proving the metaphysical admission of any such family. The reverse profile characterization supplies an extensional restriction, not its warrant or governance. A warranted necessary or primitive restriction may genuinely terminate a containment demand; explaining an exemption still does not explain the actual existence of its bearer. The strongest developed rival candidate retains a stable brute foundation, constitutive and history restrictions with the needed scope, and fallible causal or prima facie warrant. It remains a candidate package, not a certified globally possible worldview. Classical theism has conditional additional explanatory content if it supplies adequate actual existential explanation and reason-guided production; necessity alone supplies neither agency nor trustworthy historical access. The prior moderate preference for E and suspension about universal determining D are retained, not strengthened by counting formal consequences. Internal contradiction requires the rival's own incompatible exclusion or entitlement norm plus its admitted countercase; bruteness alone does not supply it. Its qualified semantic review was at 9c9cf4fc1f1786f6201c0d453789936d399ee0cc, with the exact review and publication history in that section and PR-1927. The current source/exercise continuation below does not reverse that scoped assessment.

Retrospective proof-coverage audit, issue #2103 slice 1. Analyst formulations with attribution deferred. (a) The #1913 founder premise permits different detector outputs only under the stated population boundaries and retained background (PopulationEntry.entryComparison, statement c37994de, argument 6945eaa7, result 9a461665; definitions 2d8e788b, 60b36398, 97f37f5c, d513fb8a, e7302a28). The positive late-entry witness is supplied by the unrestricted birth-input case. Conservation and capacity-one cases retain the same brute founder while restricting entries. PairedInterventions.inputRange (fd3c2ed2, 3c2c5f55, 495c506a, definition a3876b86) evaluates the reachable tuples of the paired input map, and the supplied unmatched endpoint frees the parity constraint. offsetAccuracy (77f924d5, 90379361, f7102f11, definition eee96f99) gives exact XOR-change truth iff offsets agree. These results already specify the available operations and readout. StructuralCausalModel surgery and Modal.CounterfactualSelection would require an independent map from those operations or replacements to admissible same-background alternatives. Neither supplies the closure rule. (e) The proposed unrestricted late-agent / anything-goes conclusion has no theorem from bruteness alone, or from graph connectedness alone. The stronger evidence-defeat claim e519065f lacks a method-specific entitlement bridge. These are comparative tests for 608a262d, with no derivation of it.
blocker:
The repeatable new-agent insertion route needs warrant for an unreceived onset and joint composition of its origins and exercises at the fixed background. One effective eligible addition defeats a universal ban. Other mechanisms, including separately admitted rich initial inputs, can produce arbitrary joint outputs without late entry. Crossing the particular parity boundary requires some effective change that breaks its invariant. Universal exclusion of entrants requires essential exhaustive closure or universal receipt of existence. Actual epistemic defeat needs evidence about exposure of reliable channels and the inquirer’s own entitlement standard.

Next distinct audit test. Warrant or rule out one added agent with an unreceived onset under specified conserved resources, retained bearers and independently available exercise. Test whether the favored intervention breaks the same invariant and perturbs the same channel. This decides a targeted admission or undercutting claim before any universal recombination thesis.
